---
name: Community improvement
about: Improve onboarding, documentation, governance, contributor experience, accessibility, or community growth
title: "[Community] "
---

## Community problem

Who is having difficulty and what is the friction?

## Evidence / observation

Examples: repeated newcomer questions, unclear documentation, slow review, inaccessible process, missing contribution path, community metric, or comparison with another project.

## Proposed improvement

What should change?

## Who benefits?

New visitors, first-time contributors, reviewers, maintainers, researchers, non-code contributors, international contributors, etc.

## How will we know it helped?

Suggest a measurable or observable outcome when possible.

## Risks / trade-offs

Could the change create more bureaucracy, maintenance work, exclusion, noise, or moderation burden?
